title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Chozhan sends Pandian and Pallavan away to spend time alone with Nila, who insists on going to the office. Chandayatha lovingly watches Cheran drive the car, fulfilling her wish.

title: Bigg Boss
episodeTitle: BBTam Day 48: Ramya Krishnan Takes Charge
description: Host Ramya Krishnan reviews weekly uniqueness, deals, and food raids. She corners Jason over his team switch and fight with Muniyammal, while grilling Avinash's captaincy exit.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Pooja exposes her stepmother and uncle's scheme to claim the property in her name. Her stepmother and uncle make an emotional plea, urging her to return home with them.

title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Senthil tests Swetha to see if she has turned against Vennila after bonding with Kanmani. Maya and Iniyan later surprise Kanmani and Anbu with a sand-and-clay family figurine.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Gomathi makes Thangamayil promise never to leave home under any circumstances. Meanwhile, Pandian angrily confronts Senthil for using store money for personal expenses.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Vijaya struggles to resist the aroma of Meena's cooking. Unaware of the fast she's observed, Manoj brings home Biryani, which the family enjoys as Vijaya fights her cravings.

title: Super Singer Junior
description: Super Singer's wildcard round brings comebacks, golden buzzers, and touching stories. A standout singer moves the judges to secure the fourth finalist spot.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Swetha is terrified when Karna appears in her dream in the middle of the night. Prabhakaran advises Vetri to win back Abinaya's love through sincere care and affection.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Kalamma celebrates Siddharth's unopposed election bid and causes public trouble. Paraman later serves locals with water, winning Ilamathi's praise, who urges him to run.
